environment_detail: NOT RUN, no ARM64 system was available. The record stands for the arm64-v8a library of the Legacy APK, built with the android-21 sysroot (the first API level that has that ABI), so that the Legacy APK also runs on 64-bit-only phones (research R3). Its verdict is not_tested.
eol_source: validation/sources.json eol-android-security: Android versions below 14 are end of life for the backend.
release_date_source: General availability of Android 5.0 (2014-11-12, author's knowledge, not re-read); age_years = days to 2026-11-14 divided by 365.25 = 12.0.
floor_note: Not a floor. API 21 to 23 are below the Modern UI floor (API 24) and are served by the Legacy UI (spec SC-001).
